summary.text: Nader Hashim is the Democratic incumbent state senator for the Windham District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A former state representative and paralegal, he chairs the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hashim was born in Boston, Massachusetts, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and international relations from Clark University in 2011.
His career experience includes work in law enforcement with the Vermont State Police and as a paralegal at a private law firm.
Hashim served in the Vermont House of Representatives for Windham 4 from 2019 to 2021 and joined the Senate in 2023.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Judiciary Committee, which he chairs.
